name: audit-compliance-dashboard
title: Audit Compliance Dashboard
description: An enterprise regulatory readiness dashboard showing SOC2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA control checks with evidence logs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Compliance Controls Checklist Tracker: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
